subject: general
question: In which year was the Department of Sports transformed into the Department of Youth Affairs and Sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1985**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Department of Sports was transformed into the Department of Youth Affairs and Sports in the year **1985**.
 
• This transformation aimed to give focused attention to the development and promotion of sports and youth affairs in India.
 
• The Department of Youth Affairs and Sports is responsible for the development and implementation of policies and programs that promote youth engagement and sports activities across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Department of Youth Affairs and Sports was established under the Ministry of Human Resource Development initially.
 
• In 2000, it became part of the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, which was created as an independent ministry.
 
• The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports is responsible for creating an environment that encourages sports excellence and youth development.
 
• Various schemes and programs are implemented by the ministry to support athletes, promote physical fitness, and foster youth development.
 
• The ministry also collaborates with state governments, sports federations, and other stakeholders to achieve its objectives.
